run_main: run the main function to generate an MNE HTML diagnosis report with event boundary plots for dataset recordings
run_plot_events: run plot_events to visualize event boundaries on a matplotlib axis with an optional time window
run_list_selections: run list_selections to retrieve available dataset selections with their associated keyword arguments
run_bm_env_temporary: run bm.env.temporary as a context manager to set a temporary cache directory for dataset operations
run_mne_report: run mne.Report to create an HTML report with system info, figures, and success status for diagnosis
